text: dsh-orchestrator 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的多代理调度插件，在宿主中注册 delegate 与 orchestrate 工具，并在会话输入区提供计划开关和模型路由面板。用户可以把一项自包含任务交给子代理异步执行，也可以按条目和阶段声明批量工作流；子代理使用面板配置的默认模型路由，独立任务可并行启动。插件还提供计划阶段显示和长任务巡检入口，帮助主代理跟踪子代理进度并收取结果。适合需要把工作拆给多个代理、运行批量分阶段任务并为主代理与子代理设置不同模型的 DSH 用户。代码未显示插件自身要求额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-orchestrator adds task delegation and batch orchestration to the DSH web client. It registers delegate and orchestrate tools and provides a plan toggle and model-routing panel. Send a task to a subagent or run a staged batch, then receive results in the main agent.
我想把一个独立任务交给 DSH 子代理去做，完成后把结果带回来。
怎样让多个代理并行处理一批有固定步骤的工作？
I want separate default model routes for my main agent and its workers.
dsh-orchestrator 的功能「委派任务」：主代理调用 delegate 并提供任务说明和完整提示词，即可启动一个子代理；工具立即返回子代理标识，工作结束后宿主把结果交回主代理。
dsh-orchestrator 的功能「批量编排」：主代理调用 orchestrate，传入条目与阶段提示词，插件据此安排多个子代理执行单阶段扇出或逐条目多阶段流水线，并收集结果。

dsh-orchestrator README · 为什么有了原生 `subagent` 和 `Agent Team`，还需要这个插件？：| 痛点场景 | 原生 `subagent` / 官方 `Agent Team` | DSH Orchestrator（本插件独有） | | --- | --- | --- | | **如何省钱配模型？**
*(最核心差异)* | **无独立子代理面板**：子代理要么默认继承昂贵的主模型，要么靠主模型每次调用时自己传参选模型（容易忘传或乱选，改默认模型还得改静态配置） | **双路由独立面板 + 强制锁定便宜模型**：在 UI 面板直接把 Main Agent 设为昂贵强模型（如 `gemini-4-argon-high`），把 Subagent 统一锁死为廉价快模型（如 `gemini-3.8-flash`），改完下一次委派立即生效 | | **主代理总忍不住自己动手？** | **靠自觉（软提示词）**：主代理 / Team Lead 手里依然握有 `read`、`edit`、`bash` 等全套工具，聊几轮就经常脱轨亲自去读文件、跑命令，瞬间撑爆主上下文 | **白名单式驱动（Whitelist-Driven Hard Gate）**：主代理默认仅放行 12 项规划与委派核心工具（`allowedTools`），其余一切宿主读写/终端工具及未来新增的 MCP/第三方插件工具一律自动隐藏并在执行层强制拦截（连 `run_code` 嵌套偷调也拦），**逼迫 Main Agent 100% 只做规划与验收，Subagent 100% 只干苦力活** | | **便宜模型干活卡死/跑偏怎么办？** | **运行期黑盒**：派出后只能干等结束或超时，或者靠 `wait_agent` 阻塞轮询 | **零 Token 后台巡检唤醒**：后台定时静默扫描子代理事件日志（不调模型、零 Token 消耗），超时或卡壳时自动汇总摘要唤醒主代理，由强模型发消息精准纠偏 | | **大批量同构任务怎么跑？** | 原生 `workflow` 让模型手写任意 JS 脚本，容易失控且模型路由不统一 | **声明式 `orchestrate` 流水线**：`items × stages` 结构化扇出与多阶段流水线，单项失败隔离、支持 JSON Schema 强校验，全部 Worker 强制走便宜的子代理路由 |

dsh-orchestrator README · 1. 强模型当 Main Agent，便宜模型当 Subagent（独立面板、即时生效）：在输入框下方的**「调度模式」专属面板**中，主代理与子代理的模型路由完全解耦：
- **主代理（Main Agent）**：配置为你最强的旗舰模型（例如 `gpt-astra-6`、`claude-opus-5.5` 等），专门负责需求澄清、任务切分、途中纠偏与最终结果验收。
- **子代理（Subagent）**：配置为能力稍弱但极其便宜、高吞吐的模型（例如 `deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`gpt-luna-6` 等），**所有通过 `delegate` 和 `orchestrate` 派出的 Worker 强制共用这条便宜路由**（除非用户在当前消息里明确点名要求临时换模型）。
- **防烧钱保护**：如果未配置子代理模型，派发时会直接报错拦截，**绝不静默回退去烧昂贵的主代理模型**。

dsh-orchestrator README · 2. 主代理「规划与验收」、子代理「纯粹 Work」的白名单式硬性闸门：不同于靠 Prompt 劝主模型“多用子代理”，本插件在 DSH 工具层安装了双重守卫（`tools.restrict` + `tools.guard`），且采用**白名单式驱动**：
- **主代理被彻底收缴执行工具**：`DEFAULT_ALLOWED_TOOLS` 默认只放行 12 项规划、委派与会话只读工具——`delegate`、`orchestrate`、`send_message`、`interrupt_agent`、`todo_write`、`ask_user_question`、`compress` 与 5 项只读会话日志工具。所有文件读写（`read` / `edit` / `write` / `apply_patch`）、搜索（`grep` / `glob`）、终端（`bash` / `pwsh`）、网页抓取、原生 `subagent` / `workflow`，以及未来新增的任何 MCP / 第三方插件工具，一律自动隐藏并在执行层强制拦截（连 `run_code` 嵌套偷调也拦）。需要额外放行时，在面板右侧 Allowed Tools 勾选即可。
- **子代理独享完整工具链**：被派出的 Worker 不受闸门限制，在各自独立的上下文中读写文件、跑测试、看报错，完工后只把干净的结论交回主代理验收。
- **一键随时切换**：需要主代理临时亲自操作时，关掉面板上的「启用调度模式」开关即可立刻恢复主代理的全部工具，无需重开会话。
section: 2. 主代理「规划与验收」、子代理「纯粹 Work」的白名单式硬性闸门

text:
dsh-orchestrator README · 3. 零 Token 后台巡检与强模型动态纠偏：便宜模型充当 Subagent 时，偶尔会在复杂的 shell 转义或报错上打转。插件内置了纯日志驱动的后台巡检器：
- **零额外 Token 消耗**：后台定时器直接读取运行中 Worker 的会话事件日志（不调用任何 LLM），按设定的巡检间隔（默认 600 秒）汇总它的运行时长、轮次、新增工具调用与最后输出，合并成一条通知唤醒主代理。
- **强模型一眼把关**：主代理收到巡检摘要后，只需极少 Token 即可做出决策：
  - **A) 进展正常**：回复一行 `巡检：正常` 结束回合，让子代理继续跑；
  - **B) 途中纠偏**：调用 `send_message` 直接向运行中的子代理注入修正指令（指明正确写法或跳过卡点）；
  - **C) 及时止损**：调用 `interrupt_agent` 中断失控的子代理（若后续再用 `send_message` 重新唤醒它，巡检会自动重新接管并重置通知计数）。
section: 3. 零 Token 后台巡检与强模型动态纠偏

text:
dsh-orchestrator README · 4. 专为调度模式定制的 `delegate` 与 `orchestrate`：- **`delegate`（按需异步单派 / 并行扇出）**：
  用于派发自包含的独立任务（目标 + 允许修改的文件 + 验收命令 + 失败兜底）。同一回合多次调用即可同时启动多个 Worker 并行施工；插件会为每个子代理统一注入简体中文回复指令，并要求它在收尾时直接输出最终总结、禁止调用 `send_message` 向父代理汇报（收尾消息会自动送达主代理）。
- **`orchestrate`（声明式批量流水线）**：
  用于处理「一组条目（`items`，1–64）× 固定多阶段步骤（`stages`，1–8）」的批量任务，通过 `maxConcurrency`（1–16，默认 4）控制并发。支持单阶段并行扇出与多阶段**逐条目无屏障流水线**（先做完阶段 1 的条目立刻进入阶段 2，不用傻等慢条目），支持阶段级 JSON Schema 强校验与单项失败隔离。

dsh-orchestrator README · DSH Orchestrator：[](https://github.com/SShiRkiT/dsh-orchestrator)

The "dispatch mode" plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

The main agent only clarifies, plans, slices work, and accepts results

Every concrete action is handed to subagents through `delegate` (asynchronous, on demand) or `orchestrate` (declarative batch).

The main agent and the subagents have their default models and reasoning effort configured independently, and all subagents share the same subagent route.

[中文](README.md)

dsh-orchestrator README · How it differs from a plain single-agent session：| | Plain single-agent session | Dispatch mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Who executes | the main model calls tools itself | workers execute; the main agent only dispatches |
| Context | tool output piles up in the main agent context | each worker carries its own context |
| Parallelism | tool calls complete one after another | several workers run at once |
| Models | one model does everything | two routes, main agent and subagent |
| Boundaries | the model is expected to comply | the gate refuses by force |
section: How it differs from a plain single-agent session

text: dsh-orchestrator README · Key features：a whitelist of 12 built-in planning and delegation tools (`DEFAULT_ALLOWED_TOOLS` / `allowedTools`) is all the main agent may call; every read, write, shell, web, and other host tool — plus any MCP or third-party plugin tool registered later — is hidden and refused at execution time (even a nested call smuggled through `run_code`); the main agent keeps only `delegate`, `orchestrate`, `send_message`, `todo_write`, `ask_user_question`, `compress`, `interrupt_agent`, plus the read-only session log tools (`session_*`).

dsh-orchestrator README · Key features：- **Parallel dispatch of independent subtasks**:

Independent subtasks go out together in the same turn; `delegate` has no plugin-side concurrency cap, while `orchestrate` limits how many workers are alive at once with `maxConcurrency` (1–16, default 4).

- **Supervision and correction**:

dsh-orchestrator README · Key features：When a `delegate` worker runs long, the plugin merges its session log into one notice that wakes the main agent; the main agent corrects it with a concrete `send_message`, or decides no intervention is needed and ends the turn with a one-line note.

When a worker is interrupted with `interrupt_agent` and later woken again by `send_message`, supervision takes it back: the notice count restarts from the first notice, and the log from before the interruption does not count as new activity.

dsh-orchestrator README · Key features：*Each patrol notice summarises one running subagent — elapsed time, rounds, steps, new tool calls since the last patrol, latest tool, and last output — and the main agent then chooses to leave it alone (replying one line 「巡检：正常」), correct it with `send_message`, or terminate. In the screenshot the main agent sends corrective guidance to a subagent stuck on shell quoting and backslashes.*

- **Collecting results**:

dsh-orchestrator README · Key features：`delegate` returns `{ kind: "activation", subagentId }` immediately, and when the worker finishes the host delivers its result to the main agent as a message; `orchestrate` collects every result synchronously inside the tool call.

- **Declarative orchestration**:

`orchestrate` does single-stage fan-out and multi-stage per-item pipelines (no global barrier); results keep input order, one failed item does not sink the others, and a stage can declare an object schema for structured results.

dsh-orchestrator README · Configuration：The main agent's default route is not part of this configuration: it lives in the host's `agent-default-model` (`provider` / `model` / `reasoningEffort`), is written by the same panel, and is read when a new agent is created.

dsh-orchestrator README · delegate: one self-contained dynamic task：It has only three parameters: `prompt` (the complete task, required), `description` (a 3–5 word display name, required), and `cwd` (optional). The worker cannot see the main agent's conversation, so the prompt has to carry all the context itself:

dsh-orchestrator README · delegate: one self-contained dynamic task：Every worker gets the same fixed instruction at the start of its prompt: `用中文回复。` (answer in Simplified Chinese), followed by the requirement to end the turn with the final summary in the reply and not to call `send_message` to report completion, because the parent receives the closing message automatically. For several independent tasks, call `delegate` once each in the same message and they all start at once.

dsh-orchestrator README · orchestrate: batch dispatch：With several stages, items advance one by one and a later stage automatically receives the earlier output of the same item. `items` is 1–64 and `stages` is 1–8; the call returns `{ kind: "orchestration", agentsStarted, results, errors }`, with `results` in input order and `null` for a failed item.

`delegate` is asynchronous: there is no progress callback, and the main agent has no tool to stop a worker — stopping one takes a host-side action.
